sn21.4:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena aññataro navo bhikkhu pacchābhattam piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto vihāram pavisitvā appossukko tunhībhūto saṅkāsāyati || na bhikkhūnaṃ veyyāvaccam karoti cīvarakārasamaye || || 3
sn21.4:1.3: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || || 4 Ekam antaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū Bhagavantam etad avocuṃ || ||
sn21.4:1.4: Idha bhante aññataro navo bhikkhu pacchābhattam piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto vihāram pavisitvā appossukko tuṇhībhūto saṅkasāyati || na bhikkhūnaṃ veyyāvaccaṃ karoti cīvarakārasamaye ti || || 5
sn21.4:2.1: Atha kho Bhagavā aññataram bhikkhum āmantesi || ||
sn21.4:2.2: Ehi tvam bhikkhu mama vacanena tam bhikkhum āmantehi Satthā tam āvuso āmantetīti || || 6
sn21.4:2.3: Evam bhanteti kho so bhikkhu Bhagavato paṭissutvā yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā tam bhikkhum etad avoca || ||
sn21.4:2.5: Evam āvuso ti kho so bhikkhu tassa bhikkhuno paṭissutvā yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 8 Ekam antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho tam bhikkhum Bhagavā etad avoca || ||
sn21.4:2.6: Saccaṃ kira tvaṃ bhikkhu pacchābhattam piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto vihāraṃ pavisitvā appossukko tuṇhībhūto saṅkasāyasi || na bhikkhūnaṃ veyyāvaccaṃ karosi cīvarakārasamayeti || ||
sn21.4:2.7: Aham pi kho bhante sakaṃ kiccaṃ karomīti || || 9
sn21.4:3.1: Atha kho Bhagavā tassa bhikkhuno cetasā cetoparivitakkam aññāya bhikkhū āmantesi || ||
sn21.4:3.2: Mā kho tumhe bhikkhave etassa bhikkhuno vijjhāyittha ||
sn21.4:3.3: Eso kho bhikkhave bhikkhu catunnaṃ jhānānam abhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhī || || Yassacatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyam pabbajanti || tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭhevadhamme sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatīti || || 10
sn21.4:4.2: idaṃ vatvāna Sugato athāparam etad avoca satthā || ||
